merchant_note: This merchant holds 1,964 orders/order_items -- 2 full duplicate copies of the same 982 real orders, per Prompt 2's intentional duplicate-ingestion test (E2-2). All figures below reflect that duplicated state, as expected.

endpoint_discovery.method: Read app/routes/ecommerce.py in full and grepped for every @router.get/post decorator -- confirmed 3 endpoints registered under the /dashboard/ path prefix (not assumed from the specification).
endpoint_discovery.note: All 3 match the specification's example names exactly (dashboard/summary, dashboard/revenue, dashboard/sku-matrix) -- confirmed via repository reading, not assumed.

rbac_and_access_setup.finding: The pre-existing RBAC row for this merchant (user_id=1, vertical=ecommerce, role=owner) was confirmed UNUSABLE via a direct get_merchant_role() call returning None, despite appearing present under a raw SQL SELECT -- same root cause as Bank QA's B3-4 (36-character dashed UUID string vs. the ORM's 32-character hex form). New issue E3-3 logged. Fixed by inserting one additional, ORM-consistent UserMerchantRole row (same user_id/merchant_id/vertical, role=owner) -- the original malformed row was left untouched.
rbac_and_access_setup.rbac_denial_confirmed: A separate, never-granted merchant_id correctly returned 403 FORBIDDEN.
rbac_and_access_setup.invalid_input_confirmed: merchant_id='not-a-uuid' correctly returned 400 INVALID_MERCHANT_ID rather than a crash.

response_envelope_verification.all_3_endpoints: Confirmed exact match to {success, data, meta:{missing_fields, disabled_features, analysis_run_id}} in every call for this merchant, including the explicit-date-range call.

explicit_date_range_test.independent_verification: Recomputed via direct SQL for the exact (non-calendar-aligned) equal-length previous-period window the code actually uses (period_length=30 days, so previous period = 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-31, NOT the full calendar month of March): current gross=6,648,000, previous gross=5,296,000, change_pct=(6648000-5296000)/5296000*100=25.53% -- matches the endpoint's returned 25.5% exactly.

dashboard_revenue_verification.refund_handling_check: 124 of 1,964 orders have status='refunded' (confirmed via direct SQL), totaling gross_revenue=4,192,000 and refund_amount=2,006,000 (partial refunds, ~47.9% of their own gross on average -- exactly matching the gap_breakdown's 'returns' component of 2,006,000). Confirmed the code applies NO status-based exclusion at all (fetch_orders_in_range/aggregate_order_list never reference Order.status) -- gross_revenue correctly still counts the full original sale amount for refunded orders, and net_revenue correctly subtracts only the real refunded amount. This produces the economically correct net effect without needing a status filter -- confirmed correct, not a defect. No order in this dataset can ever have status='cancelled' (the generic-source status resolver, _resolve_generic_status, only ever returns 'fulfilled' or 'refunded' -- confirmed in Prompt 1/2), so cancelled-order exclusion could not be tested with this dataset.

dashboard_sku_matrix_verification.negative_margin_finding: All quadrants show deeply negative margin_pct (e.g. -105.4% for SKU LMP-014). Traced to real, correctly-persisted per-item economics for this dataset (unit_price vs. unit_cogs+shipping+return_cost across many real orders sharing the same SKU) -- NOT a sku-matrix calculation defect (confirmed via exact match to independent recomputation). These figures ARE, however, inflated toward less-negative than the true fully-costed value due to E2-1 (unit_net_margin omits processing_fees/allocated_ad_spend) -- referenced, not re-logged as a new issue -- and are computed over the merchant's full, duplicated (E2-2) order_items set, so absolute revenue/margin totals per SKU are roughly double a single, non-duplicated ingestion's true figures.

cogs_coverage_at_dashboard_layer.note: 0% COGS missing for this merchant -- matches Prompt 1/2's finding that this file has full COGS coverage. profit_leak_detector/sku_matrix correctly NOT disabled.

summary: All 3 dashboard endpoints (summary, revenue, sku-matrix) return correct, schema-compliant, fully-verified output for this merchant -- 0 arithmetic mismatches across every metric checked, including an explicit date-range query and its change_pct calculation. Refund handling confirmed economically correct (no status-based exclusion needed, since the gross/net split already nets out refunds correctly). All observed data anomalies (duplicated order counts, deeply negative margins, an inflated profit_leak_count baseline) trace directly to already-known, referenced issues (E2-1, E2-2), not new dashboard-layer defects.
